QF.id: VB Fund Distribution and Channel Management_23

question.text: The expense ratio of a Regular Plan is higher than a Direct Plan because the Regular Plan includes __________.

explanation.text: The Logic: The Regular Plan's expense ratio is higher because it includes distribution costs, while the Direct Plan excludes distribution expenses and commission. The Trap: The same fund manager runs the same underlying portfolio for both plans, so the difference between the plans is driven by the inclusion or exclusion of distribution costs. Note: The cited source explicitly contrasts the Regular Plan (distribution costs included) with the Direct Plan (distribution expenses and commission excluded).
